highlights.title: Apple’s Glass-Centric 20th-Anniversary iPhone Remains on Track for 2027
highlights.description: Apple Inc. is still planning to offer a glass-centric overhaul of the iPhone for the device’s 20th anniversary, people familiar with the matter said, countering an analyst report that the move had been canceled.

highlights.title: Intel upsizes stock offering to $20 billion at $95 per share as AI demand accelerates

highlights.title: VinSpace Signs Launch Pact With SpaceX for 2027 Mission
highlights.description: VinSpace Joint Stock Co., a unit of Vingroup, signed an agreement with SpaceX to launch its first satellites next year, as it seeks to build a domestic space business spanning satellite manufacturing, operations and data services.

highlights.title: Jefferies downgrades Apple stock, cites all-glass iPhone cancellation rumor
highlights.description: Jefferies today became the latest firm to cut Apple’s stock price target in recent days, citing supply chain checks that suggest Apple has scrapped plans for a rumored all-glass iPhone expected to mark the device’s 20th anniversary next year. Here are the details.

highlights.title: iOS 27 Hints at 'Apple Reference Image' Photo Authentication
highlights.description: Apple is working on "Apple Reference Image," a photo provenance system that will verify if an image was captured with an iPhone. References to the feature were found in a privacy disclosure included in iOS 27 beta 5, but it is not live yet. According to the text, there will be a "Reference" mode option in the Camera app that users can select. Using this mode will embed provenance data in the image's metadata. Images captured with an opt-in Reference mode can be authenticated to confirm they were

highlights.title: India’s Banking Regulator Urges Lenders to Accelerate AI Spend
highlights.description: Indian lenders need to accelerate adoption of artificial intelligence by investing in technology and infrastructure besides training workers to upskill, central bank Governor Sanjay Malhotra said Tuesday.

highlights.title: AI Boom Set to Drive Singapore Growth as High as 5.5% This Year
highlights.description: Singapore upgraded its 2026 economic growth forecast anew as the artificial intelligence boom lifts trade and manufacturing, offsetting the drag from continued fighting in the Middle East.
